goal: Catch Guix build breakages, missing imports, and codesign manifest errors early in CI
Prevent packaging failures from surprising maintainers late in the release cycle
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (fanquake, sedited)
Concern about duplicate work resolved after author proposal (hebasto)
Questioned usefulness without running tests, author asked if x64 tests suffice (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it prevents release build breakages from hiding until late in the release cycle
Protects release integrity across Darwin, Linux, and Windows build targets
Reduces friction and surprises for maintainers during release binary production

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it validates build configurations rather than core functional code
Adds automated regression coverage for packaging and codesigning across platforms
Does not exercise protocol or runtime behavior that directly affects end users
